fields.description: Choose the AI backend. Configure the matching section below.
fields.label: Provider

fields.description: If the selected provider fails (unreachable, wrong key, rate-limited), automatically retry with Ollama. Requires Ollama to be installed and running.
fields.label: Enable Ollama Fallback

fields.description: Google API key. Get one at aistudio.google.com (free tier available).
fields.label: Gemini API Key

fields.description: Model ID. gemini-2.0-flash is fast and cheap; gemini-1.5-pro is more capable.
fields.label: Gemini Model

fields.description: URL where the Ollama server is running.
fields.label: Ollama Base URL

fields.description: Model name to use for extraction and chat (must be pulled in Ollama).
fields.label: Ollama Model

fields.description: Seconds to wait for the AI provider before giving up.
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)

fields.description: API key from platform.openai.com, or from the compatible service set in Base URL.
fields.label: OpenAI API Key

fields.description: Model ID your OpenAI account (or compatible service) offers.
fields.label: OpenAI Model

fields.description: Leave empty for OpenAI. Set it to use an OpenAI-compatible service such as Azure OpenAI, OpenRouter, Groq or a vLLM server.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: Anthropic API key. Get one at console.anthropic.com.
fields.label: Claude API Key

fields.description: Model ID, for example claude-opus-5-5, claude-sonnet-5-5 or claude-haiku-5-5.
fields.label: Claude Model

fields.description: Custom AI persona for chat and voice replies. Leave empty to use the default assistant prompt.
fields.label: System Prompt

fields.description:
Language the AI will use when replying to text and voice commands. 
Default: 'Auto' detects the language from each message.
fields.label: Response Language

fields.description: ISO 639-1 code for voice input (e.g. 'ar', 'en'). Leave empty to auto-detect.
fields.label: Voice Transcription Language

fields.description: Minimum confidence score (0.0–1.0) to auto-accept extraction results. Below this threshold the widget pauses and asks the user to review before post-processors fire.
fields.label: Confidence Threshold

fields.description: Cosine similarity threshold (0.0–1.0) for scope enforcement. Messages scoring below this against the workflow scope_description are rejected as out-of-scope. Lower = more permissive.
fields.label: Scope Similarity Threshold

fields.description:
Per Field — One model call per field. Slowest but most reliable. Best for small hardware or unstable models.
Batch — One call for all fields at once. Fastest, but a single malformed response fails every field.
Batch with Fallback — Tries batch first; automatically retries any failed field individually. Best of both worlds.
Parallel — Fires all per-field calls concurrently. Fast without the batch JSON risk, but causes a higher CPU/RAM spike.
fields.label: Extraction Mode
fields.options:
Per Field
Batch
Batch with Fallback
Parallel

fields.description: Keep the Ollama model in RAM between requests. Eliminates cold-start delay (10–30 s) at the cost of permanent memory usage (amount varies by the Ollama model size set in the Ollama Configuration section).
fields.label: Keep Model Loaded

fields.description: Master switch. When enabled, incoming WhatsApp messages are processed by the AI engine.
fields.label: Enable AI on WhatsApp

fields.description: Default account used for AI-generated outgoing replies.
fields.label: WhatsApp Account

fields.description: Workflow that governs AI WhatsApp sessions.
fields.label: AI Workflow for WhatsApp

fields.description: Soft target. Replies longer than this are split into multiple messages.
fields.label: Max Reply Length (chars)

fields.description: WhatsApp-specific system prompt. Use plain text only — no markdown. WhatsApp renders asterisks and underscores literally.
fields.label: WhatsApp System Prompt

fields.description: Map document type keys to Frappe routes. The widget offers a 'Go to...' button after classifying a document in global mode.
fields.label: Route Map

fields.description: Let the assistant prepare changes (create, update, submit, cancel, delete). Every change is shown to the user and runs only after they confirm it.
fields.label: Allow Agent Mode

fields.description: DocTypes the assistant must never change, in addition to users, roles, permissions and these settings.
fields.label: Excluded DocTypes

fields.description: Roles allowed to see and use the widget. Leave empty to allow all logged-in users.
fields.label: Allowed Roles
